parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $\frac12(4^2)\left(2\pi-\text{their }\theta\right)$, or $\frac12(4^2)(\text{their }\theta)$, or $\frac12(4^2)\sin(\text{their }\theta)$ — *M1 for a correct formula with $\text{their }\theta>0$ or $2\pi-\text{their }\theta>0$; triangle and/or minor sector may appear in a minor-segment formula. Route 1: $\frac12(4^2)(2\pi-\text{their }\theta)+\frac12(4^2)\sin(\text{their }\theta)$ — DM1, adding the relevant sector with $2\pi-\text{their }\theta>0$ and the triangle with $\text{their }\theta>0$. Route 2: $16\pi-\left[\frac12(4^2)(\text{their }\theta)-\frac12(4^2)\sin(\text{their }\theta)\right]$ — DM1, subtracting the triangle with $\text{their }\theta>0$ from the sector with $\text{their }\theta>0$, then subtracting from the circle. $\frac{32\pi}{3}+4\sqrt3$ — A1 OE, exact only. SC B2 following M0DM0 for 40.4 AWRT. Total 3.
